rename_rule: KLGJ remains a historical alias only. New architecture, reports, artifacts and user-facing references use PIPPI.
name_origin: User-selected name after Pippi Longstocking, the first book the user remembers reading.
role: Persistent append-only learning/resource journal around the complete JANUS pivot-learning loop, with continuous Spider chunking and an end-of-cycle mirror read by Pivot-Slime and Keymaster.

spider_binding.spider_role_inside_pippi: Continuously convert PIPPI event ranges into provenance-preserving chunks, weave candidate relations across gain/loss/resource/learning signals, preserve negative edges, surface unexplained deltas and hand them to TOPA CORE for falsification/calibration.
spider_binding.topa_core_role_inside_pippi: Attack Spider-created relations for confounding, replay inflation, cross-formula leakage, hardware mismatch, unsupported causal attribution and graph-density-as-evidence errors.

mirror.purpose: Let Pivot-Slime and Keymaster compare the just-finished cycle with matched history and understand what was learned, where resource was saved or lost, what remains uncertain and whether marginal gain is slowing.
mirror.pivot_slime_use: Use mirror context as advisory training/retrieval context for the next cycle; do not treat it as a proof label unless the underlying target comes from exact receipts.
mirror.keymaster_use: Use mirror context to adjust which exact checks are attempted first, diversify alternatives and avoid previously documented waste/regressions; exact JANUS still decides every move.

canonical_cycle: 0. PIPPI opens the cycle with the current frozen baseline/checkpoint context.
1. JUXTAPOSE/Exact JANUS generates or replays pivot trajectories and receipts.
2. M2R-PM stores exact experiences and retrieves structurally related history.
3. JGPT teacher learns route/resource targets from exact receipts.
4. Pivot-Slime proposes compact top-k pivot navigation.
5. TOPA DETECTIVE SPIDER observes the active evidence stream and PIPPI journal, continuously creating provenance chunks and weaving candidate relations.
6. TOPA CORE falsifies/calibrates Spider relations before they become advisory knowledge.
7. Keymaster fuses M2R, JGPT, Pivot-Slime, Detective outputs and current cap into a ranked route.
8. Exact JANUS replay accepts/rejects the attempted pivot and records the authoritative receipt.
9. PIPPI appends the exact result, resource spend, training/calibration cost and comparable gain/regression metrics.
10. Spider closes/updates affected PIPPI chunks, searches new cross-chunk relations and sends them through TOPA CORE.
11. PIPPI MIRROR is generated from exact journal facts plus explicitly tagged Detective hypotheses/falsification outcomes.
12. Pivot-Slime and Keymaster read the mirror before the next cycle to see what they actually learned and where they wasted or gained resource.
13. The next cycle starts; mirror advice may change search order but never proof semantics.

historical_state.note: Existing KLGJ seed is imported into PIPPI without rewriting historical event identities; the rename changes presentation/integration semantics, not measured values.
